description: Header file defining functions for geometric transformations such as rotation, scaling, and translation, intended for use with Lua scripting.

methods.name: rotateX
methods.description: Rotates geometry around the X axis, taking a Lua state.

methods.name: rotateY
methods.description: Rotates geometry around the Y axis, taking a Lua state.

methods.name: rotateZ
methods.description: Rotates geometry around the Z axis, taking a Lua state.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Rotates geometry in 2D, taking a Lua state.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Scales geometry in X, Y, and optionally Z, taking a Lua state.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates geometry in X, Y, and optionally Z, taking a Lua state.
